name: Quality Craft Wood Works Inc
old_description: Your kitchen is the heart of the home. It’s where meals are prepared, memories are made, and friends and family gather. That’s why Quality Craft Woodworks specializes in crafting kitchen cabinets Utah homeowners can trust for durability, elegance, and function. Every detail matters in a kitchen — from soft close hinges to the type of wood, the layout of the drawers, and the way your appliances integrate with the design. Our cabinet makers use high-quality materials to ensure your cabinets not only look stunning but also stand the test of time.
about:
Quality Craft Wood Works Inc. was established in 1980 in Rocky Ridge, Utah, a small community south of Salt Lake City. The company began with a focus on service, building its reputation primarily through customer referrals. No founders are named in available records, and ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom cabinetry for residential spaces, including kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, built-in entertainment centers, and home office shelving. Operations cover in-house design, manufacturing, and installation, with a selection of over 30 wood species and finish colors. The company serves Northern Utah from its Rocky Ridge facility, though facility size and employee count are not published.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and interior designers undertaking kitchen remodels, bathroom upgrades, and new-home projects. The firm cites hundreds of completed projects across the region, with examples ranging from modern minimalist kitchens to classic wood cabinetry.

Quality Craft Wood Works emphasizes personal attention over mass-produced alternatives, offering a limited one-year warranty on its cabinets. Its stated mission ties quality cabinetry to broader community welfare, highlighting precision machining, affordable pricing, and a commitment to durability.
